# Contributing to To-Do List App

Thank you for your interest in contributing! Here's how you can help.

## Getting Started

1. Fork the repository
2. Clone your fork locally
3. Create a new branch for your feature/fix
4. Make your changes
5. Test thoroughly
6. Submit a pull request

## Development Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/todo-list-app.git
cd todo-list-app
# Open index.html in your browser or use:
python -m http.server 8000
```

## Code Style

- Use consistent indentation (2 spaces)
- Use meaningful variable names
- Add comments for complex logic
- Follow the existing code structure
- Use ES6+ features

## Testing

Before submitting:
- Test on multiple browsers
- Test on mobile devices
- Test all features (add, delete, complete, export, import, filter)
- Verify local storage works correctly
- Check for console errors

## Commit Messages

- Use clear, descriptive commit messages
- Start with a verb (Add, Fix, Update, Remove)
- Example: "Add dark mode toggle feature"

## Pull Request Process

1. Provide a clear description of changes
2. Reference any related issues
3. Include screenshots if UI changes are made
4. Ensure code passes basic validation
5. Wait for review before merging

## Feature Requests

Open an issue with:
- Clear feature description
- Use case/benefit
- Possible implementation approach

## Bug Reports

Include:
- Browser and OS
- Steps to reproduce
- Expected behavior
- Actual behavior
- Console errors if any

## Questions?

Open an issue or check existing discussions for help.

Thank you for contributing! 🎉
